g.text: Managed Metadata to CampusClaw Runtime Directory
No remote tool list is written to disk.
The tree is read-only between publications.
Name and path must match byte-for-byte.
Refresh does not mutate active snapshots.
Complete cache hits do not call Mate.
Refresh failure keeps the old directory.
No TTL or version-driven auto refresh.
Keep the current model while it remains callable.
Otherwise select the usable new default.
Reject before accepting a User Entry if none exists.
